description: Phase 0 data contract: the one source of truth for canonical counts, searchable collections, record identifiers, provenance fields, confidence labels, and source availability. No search surface may contradict this manifest. Version 1.0.0, 2026-10-09.

availability.description: What this manifest instance could and could not verify.

collections.description: Searchable collections. Rows from different collections are never merged or deduplicated against each other.

badge.description: Badge text rendered on every result card.

aliases.description: Secondary identifier forms mapped to the canonical id (e.g. Barak source-row ids).

canonical_pattern.description: Regex for the canonical identifier form.

normalization.description: Ordered normalization rules applied before matching (see contract §2).

provenance_fields.description: Every field a result card from this collection must carry (see contract §5).

record_count_ref.description: Key into the top-level counts object, when a count applies to this collection.

source_availability.description: Whether the backing index is verifiable in the repo snapshot, requires a live service, was deliberately excluded, or mixed.

confidence_labels.description: Labels describe transcription/identification/provenance quality of the record — never confidence that an allegation is true.

counts.description: Every public count with its exact meaning. Rule: never equate indexed research records with verified downloadable files.

meaning.const: Review rows in the public Barak portal index snapshot.

reconciliation.description: Relationship to recovered-parent/attachment-slot/placeholder counts is Subagent C's work; stays 'pending' until reconciled.

meaning.const: Files under evidence-data/** in the production source tree, per frontdoor/archive-status.json. This is the one public archive-file count.
meaning.description: Fixed meaning string; do not paraphrase on public pages.

verified_in.description: Repo path the count was derived from.

verification.description: How the value was verified. 'operator_records' means attested from the production tree, not verified in this snapshot.

reconciliation_note.description: Required when verification is not in_repo: states what the snapshot can and cannot prove about this count.

meaning.const: Rows in the operator's offline OCR/index corpus. Index rows, not individually downloadable files, not individually verified.
meaning.description: Fixed meaning string. Public pages must label this 'indexed research records', never 'files' or 'documents available'.

searchable_documents.description: BLOCKED: figure with no in-repo provenance. Either supply verified_in or remove from public surfaces.

meaning.const: Served photo/screenshot items in the visual-evidence index (duplicates excluded).

reconciliation_note.description: Must state that 76,948 manifest_rows includes 888 duplicate_rows_skipped and is not the item count.

generated_at.description: When this manifest instance was generated.

default_sort.description: Sort for non-exact results; undated records sort last with date_unknown=true.

exact_id_pinning.description: A normalized whole-query identifier pins that record first in every collection surface.

route_verification.description: Exact-identifier routes are only emitted when the manifest confirms the target exists; otherwise a missing_record response is emitted.

manifest_version.description: Semver of the manifest content. Bump minor on count updates, major on schema or collection changes.

missing_record_responses.description: Required responses for exact-ID queries with no record (see contract §7).

worker_sha256.description: SHA-256 of _worker.js in the snapshot, when available.

title: GAH Single Authoritative Search Manifest
